clinical_category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

semantic_correction.stem: A nurse is preparing for a procedure that may generate splashes or sprays of blood or body fluids toward the face. Which planned PPE protects the facial mucous membranes as recommended by CDC Standard Precautions?

options.A: Wear protective eyewear together with a mask.
options.B: Wear a mask and leave the eyes uncovered.
options.C: Wear protective eyewear and leave the nose and mouth uncovered.
options.D: Wear gloves and a gown without adding protection for the face.

semantic_correction.rationale: CDC Core Infection Prevention and Control Practices state that when procedures or activities could generate splashes or sprays of blood, body fluids, secretions, or excretions, healthcare personnel should protect the mucous membranes of the eyes, nose, and mouth using protective eyewear with a mask, or a face shield. Option A supplies eye protection together with nose-and-mouth protection. Options B and C leave part of the facial mucous membranes unprotected, and option D omits facial mucous-membrane protection.
semantic_correction.educational_objective: For anticipated splash or spray exposure to the face, protect the eyes, nose, and mouth with CDC-recommended facial PPE such as protective eyewear used with a mask.
semantic_correction.source_organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
semantic_correction.source_document_title: CDC's Core Infection Prevention and Control Practices for Safe Healthcare Delivery in All Settings
semantic_correction.source_locator: Core Practices Table — 5. Standard Precautions — 5d. Risk Assessment with Appropriate Use of Personal Protective Equipment, item 1.c
semantic_correction.source_claim_supported: For procedures or activities that could generate splashes or sprays, use protective eyewear and a mask, or a face shield, to protect the mucous membranes of the eyes, nose, and mouth; select PPE according to anticipated task exposure.

semantic_correction.correction_summary_append: RULE1 cleanup: removed the uniquely long correct option and absolute/obvious distractor pattern; rebuilt all choices as parallel PPE plans and tied the item to CDC Core Practices 5d.1.c and the exact NCSBN 2026 safety/infection-prevention activity statements.

audit_findings_append.blueprint_locator: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control, printed p. 24
audit_findings_append.finding: The original correct option was source-supported but uniquely long, while distractors were plainly deficient or used absolute wording. The revised item uses four concise PPE plans; only A protects all facial mucous membranes as required for anticipated splash/spray exposure.

option_audit.A: Correct. Protective eyewear plus a mask protects the eyes, nose, and mouth as specified by CDC.
option_audit.B: Incorrect. A mask without eye protection leaves the ocular mucous membranes exposed.
option_audit.C: Incorrect. Eye protection without a mask leaves the nose and mouth unprotected.
option_audit.D: Incorrect. Gloves and a gown do not provide the facial mucous-membrane protection required for the described splash/spray risk.

ambiguity_check: No second defensible answer. A is the only offered PPE plan that protects the eyes, nose, and mouth; a face shield would also be CDC-concordant but is not offered as a competing option.
cueing_check: Options are parallel PPE plans of similar complexity; no absolute-word cue and no uniquely long correct answer remains.

checks: current CDC Core Practices page and April 12, 2024 date confirmed
face-shield alternative checked and excluded from distractors to prevent a second answer
rationale limited to source-supported PPE claims
